analysis:
Examined all supplied source, patches and metadata. Selected-model recovery adds background residency changes affecting A-018/TB-007 and potentially TB-012/T-059. ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery.swift:35-41 restricts eligibility to selected, advertised, runtime-eligible models without self-test or retirement fences; :78-122 protects selected/request-loadable models and checks victim leases and idle time. Planning uses memory/slot requirements (:176-255), rechecks ownership after suspension (:139-140), and delegates final eviction/loading to existing gates (:284-295). Reports and logs contain model IDs, timing and failure text, not directly supplied prompts or keys. No direct changes to authorization, attestation, encryption, billing or T-041 cache scope/storage controls were observed.
Cross-file lifecycle integration adds recovery to the model-switch settlement barrier (ProviderLoop+ModelSwitch.swift:143) and shutdown task collection (ProviderLoop+Serve.swift:493). Shutdown now delegates all unloading to unloadAllModelsForShutdown (:519). No concrete regression is established by these excerpts.
Integration must verify the new shutdown helper preserves waiting and native cleanup semantics, and review recovery scheduling/cancellation, adoptionReleaseTime/releaseAdoptionForSelectedModelRecovery, evictionExclusions and unloadModel. Material gate contracts remain unverified: recovery can reach ensureModelLoaded without another pause/eligibility check after an awaited unload, or with no victims (:290-295); that gate must enforce current drain/add-on hold, retirement, selection and memory restrictions. Review these contracts against TB-012/T-059, T-029 and T-028, including shutdown cleanup and capacity publication. Missing implementations are coverage limits, not evidence of missing controls.
